_comment: The early-game hustle (game-like, abstract): Aunty Mavis' smokkie and street sales by phone.

missions.title: The Smokkie
missions.intro: Aunty Mavis: "You're the new one at No. 13? I need hands behind my counter. Bring your own stock from your crew's runner (your safehouse), serve my evening crowd, and no trouble in my place."
missions.description: Work Aunty Mavis' counter at the smokkie.

objectives.text: Serve 3 drinks at the smokkie counter (stock up at your safehouse; busy 17:00–23:00)
Tell Aunty Mavis how it went

missions.title: Bankies
missions.intro: Aunty Mavis: "People keep asking me for bankies. Give them your number and they'll call you. But SAPS walk past here every day, so watch who's looking before you hand anything over."
missions.description: Build a client list and sell on the street without getting caught.

objectives.text: Save 3 clients to your phone (chat to neighbours)
Answer calls and make 3 street deals without SAPS seeing
